cases.title: Legacy identity and compatibility
oracles: Old/new import spellings share one writer and lock; immutable historical bytes resolve exactly
Conflicting root aliases and altered historical snapshot bytes are rejected

cases.title: Existing app delivery and off
oracles: Explicit registration/use retains actual returned-as-context receipts
Stale preview, corrupt bridge and off cannot claim context retraction

cases.title: Existing installer transaction recovery
oracles: Observed durable install/reset phases recover using the same operation
Every injected interrupted phase guards readers and preserves unrelated state

cases.title: Complete legacy regression subject
oracles: All discovered Instructions modules run under the prepared interpreter
Record native/npm prerequisites and skips; empty discovery or missing required coverage is not green

cases.title: Package, ontology and mirror boundary
oracles: Package inventory, exact mirrors, ontology and negative controls judge the integrated index
New test suite omission, unshipped runtime and author code in payload fail by name

cases.title: Frozen contract conformance
oracles: Positive versioned request/source/result examples round-trip
Reject unknown required semantics, duplicate keys, altered signed bytes and empty test-discovery/oracle sets. Legitimate empty memory/selection remains valid.

cases.title: Account-free identity
oracles: Personal work starts without Team/signup/network; renamed profile/rotated credential retains identity
Names, local host/task IDs and a second key cannot impersonate an enrolled principal or independent human

cases.title: Lock/signout barrier
oracles: Explicit local proof reenters valid offline scope after durable lock/signout
Old CLI/MCP/child handles, restart, background refresh, late response and expired controls cannot silently reopen access; dispatched commit retains its original result

cases.title: Target protected-entry admission
oracles: New role-specific compilation and permitted personal work use explicit supported owner boundaries
Every retained current CLI/owner/catalog/install/setup/import/host route, including --repo and custom roots, rejects denied protected resources; removed routes do not silently fall through

cases.title: Durable object/control storage
oracles: Verified immutable objects plus owned conditional head and operation receipt survive process restart
Crash at each observed durable boundary, same-ID/different payload, advanced base and forked lineage cannot produce duplicate or falsely committed state
Restore a consistent covered local-state backup after losing the live database, including private candidate/draft, outbox and unknown-request/receipt/control mappings
Incomplete/mixed backup, missing required objects, invalid control/time evidence and post-backup changes cannot be silently declared fully recovered or reactivate an authority

atomic_cases.title: Consistent local backup restore
atomic_cases.positive: Covered C03-level draft/outbox/unknown request and control mappings restore exactly after live DB loss
atomic_cases.negative: Source-only peer inventory or surviving-DB restart is not this proof

atomic_cases.title: Backup DB/object closure
atomic_cases.positive: A supported consistent backup binds exact DB snapshot and required immutable members
atomic_cases.negative: Missing/corrupt/mixed object members give incomplete restore, never guessed acceptance

atomic_cases.title: Restore coverage horizon
atomic_cases.positive: Report the exact covered frontier and unavailable later private work under the configured recovery objective
atomic_cases.negative: Do not infer that post-backup unique work is absent, recovered or safe to discard

atomic_cases.title: Passive authority restoration
atomic_cases.positive: Restored sequencing/control data remains in a safe passive state until current authority/clock/key conditions are established
atomic_cases.negative: A restored copy or old access-generation state cannot auto-unlock or create another active finalizer

cases.title: Knowledge applicability
oracles: Coherent table/definition/conditions and exact future/late revisions support the selected question
Missing period/companion, source conflict, changed basis or denied evidence remains qualified instead of returning a bare current value

cases.title: Decision state closure
oracles: Multi-workstream decisions retain stated basis and typed outcomes; cross-lane corrections change current state
Required old decisions survive ranking; missing targets, cycles, competing replacements and private closure produce unresolved state or verified permitted projection

cases.title: Bounded role readers
oracles: Required meaning precedes optional ranking; finite processing/output budgets and exact cursors support expansion
Scope/frontier/auth changes reject old cursors; empty, unavailable and truncation stay different; hashes alone never satisfy child retention

cases.title: Personal and brownfield preparation
oracles: Projectless/personal/unadopted preparation uses exact sources without fake Team/session IDs
Dirty/untracked byte changes invalidate dependent work; missing why is not inferred; knowledge/memory never become instruction_text

cases.title: Manual Team enrollment
oracles: Exact founding/invite/consent/control commit supports manual device enrollment without external SSO
Changed founding proposal, delayed canceled invite, duplicate Team name, missing independent participant and reused bootstrap cannot grant access

cases.title: Rights and exact approvals
oracles: Scoped contribution/review/publication/adoption and explicit group delegation act within source ceilings
Self-add, requester/author self-review, revoked reviewer, stale policy/base and replayed request fail at owner execution, not just UI

cases.title: Environment edition and adoption
oracles: Exact flattened composition and separate owner publication/Team adoption have durable results
Floating parents, denied required material, conflicting pins, partial cross-owner publication and newer memory premises cannot silently alter old tasks

cases.title: Exchange import and restrictions
oracles: Full/incremental/return packages verify control then permitted required bodies and retain acknowledgments
Truncation, missing baseline, altered bytes, wrong audience, traversal/executable payload, stale controls and newly learned revocation during partial import fail safely

cases.title: Peer custody and recovery
oracles: Two isolated real stores exchange and reconstruct exact permitted inventory without GitHub; storage generation scopes custody
Lost finalizer stays pending; copied keys, old-disk rollback, storage reset, unavailable full package and conflicting successors cannot fake authority or complete copies

cases.title: Actual recipient adapters
oracles: Supported new/current/child/rehydrated recipient gets real bounded bodies with exact outcome evidence
Unsupported/custom-root resume bypass, incompatible context, missing reader, access change and lost responses never claim delivery or create duplicate effects

atomic_cases.title: Personal actual recipient
atomic_cases.positive: Actual bounded role bodies reach the identified personal recipient
atomic_cases.negative: Wrong recipient, missing body and invented session IDs fail

atomic_cases.title: Team actual recipient
atomic_cases.positive: Current Team grants, scoped sources and exact bodies reach the actual Team recipient
atomic_cases.negative: Revoked rights, wrong Team/recipient, unsupported resume and parent-only receipt cannot certify delivery

cases.title: Connected Studio/TUI routes
oracles: One shared actor/Team/preparation fixture traverses personal start, W01-W10, direct links and returns through real operation adapters
Review-only save, navigation-cleared missing body, stale approval and closed-Team revival are rejected through visible controls and direct submissions

cases.title: Optional GitHub carrier
oracles: Explicitly bound permitted repository exchange preserves P2P-only operation and per-Team disconnect
Preference alone causes no network/auth/upload; repository rights are not Team grants; unknown provisioning does not create duplicates

cases.title: Optional OIDC adapters
oracles: Verified Google/Slack/OIDC claims link intended principals under configured Team policy and explicit recovery
Wrong issuer/audience/workspace/nonce/replay, auto-email merge, secret export, provider outage and logout cannot create rights or override signout

cases.title: Complete Team lifecycle
oracles: Metadata, membership, device/ownership, archive/restore/leave/forget/close and evidence recovery have separate effects
Last custodian/finalizer, unfinished handoff, canceled founding, scoped continuation and closed evidence cases preserve authority and unique work

cases.title: Advanced authoring and validation
oracles: Instructions, knowledge models/forms/questions and decision/event editors create owned revisions/events; validation is pinned
Dangling graphs, lost form exceptions, arbitrary validators, partial/empty lens results and changed targets cannot become accepted clean state

cases.title: Search, derivatives, bulk and retention
oracles: Scoped search and distinct permitted derivatives lead to provider-scoped bulk results and copy-specific retention outcomes
Restricted metadata, old required decisions, mixed-batch retry, held/unknown removal and derivative rights cannot be hidden by summaries

cases.title: Disconnected end-to-end fault scenarios
oracles: Three isolated processes, controlled test clock and network policy execute a week-scale offline scenario with actual durable stores/proofs
Missed exchange, logout plus committed write, partial restrictions, finalizer loss and recovery retain exact results; never modify the user clock

cases.title: Real adapter qualification
oracles: Supported platform secret protection, native host delivery and controlled configured provider callback are observed at claimed evidence level
Missing keystore/provider/host capability is explicit unsupported/unverified; mocked keys or fake identity cannot certify production assurance

cases.title: Controlled cutover and target package
oracles: Target fresh install or explicit one-time selected-data transfer verifies before ownership changes; unfinished transfer preserves the source
Old writers are stopped before cutover; target runtime/assets/tests are correctly packaged; target-version recovery preserves new control history; no generic downgrade or legacy API support required
A source edit or new outbox item between initial conversion and writer shutdown prevents switching until the final quiesced revision is captured and validated

cases.title: AI runner evidence/replan conformance
oracles: A chosen runner resumes exact run/task/attempt IDs and consumes only accepted predecessor artifacts
Missing or stale result, cycle, conflicting file owner, changed contract, interrupted integration and skipped mandatory checks cannot mark a task accepted

atomic_cases.positive: Synthetic build and verification results unlock only their true dependents
atomic_cases.negative: Missing/stale/failed verification or wrong subject blocks terminal acceptance

cases.title: Observed user and platform usability

Record confusion, wrong-scope action and recovery errors; no time/productivity/accessibility claim from synthetic clicks alone

Reject the named negative cases without changing unrelated or unaccepted state

atomic_cases.title: Applicability versus recipient

atomic_cases.negative: Same repo or wider label cannot expose another Team source or add a processing recipient

atomic_cases.title: Cached source
atomic_cases.positive: Exact local sources support scoped authorized offline work
atomic_cases.negative: Denied/unreachable is not empty and unchanged bytes do not cancel a new qualification

atomic_cases.title: New domain

atomic_cases.negative: Unknown category cannot change Instructions domains/global ontology or auto-adopt Team content

atomic_cases.title: Single authoring home

atomic_cases.negative: Markdown and mutable JSON cannot independently edit one accepted decision; object staging alone is not committed

atomic_cases.title: Clone fork branch continuity
atomic_cases.positive: Verified worktrees share repo identity with exact observations; fork records deliberate ancestry/new authority
atomic_cases.negative: Copied manifest cannot create another writer; file absence or branch switch is not a withdrawal

atomic_cases.title: Qualified record identity

atomic_cases.title: Qualified union

oracles: Enforce the positive cases within their declared source/authority scope

atomic_cases.negative: On-disk transcript or guessed session name does not grant wider source or model access

atomic_cases.title: Disclosure boundary

atomic_cases.negative: Redaction or read permission alone cannot authorize cloud prompts, logs or another Team receipt

atomic_cases.negative: Default Team use cannot label it adopted; research does not bypass denied required sources

atomic_cases.negative: Repo-to-Team or Team-A-to-B promotion cannot silently widen authority/applicability or disclose private evidence

atomic_cases.title: Replay and unknown outcome
atomic_cases.positive: Same exact operation/source frontier returns prior result; separate sources remain attributable
atomic_cases.negative: Replays or multiple model extracts of one source cannot duplicate decisions/recurrence; unknown commit uses same ID

atomic_cases.positive: Save/present/promote reevaluates current session and source rights for fixed target
atomic_cases.negative: Logout, changed Team/policy, canceled nonce or changed selected bytes cannot redirect a late extraction

atomic_cases.title: Retention
atomic_cases.positive: Candidates, excerpts, prompts and indexes have permitted retained provenance and cleanup

atomic_cases.title: Restricted state

atomic_cases.negative: No runtime import of author-only ledger/distill scripts, shared mutable out directory or fake success fallback

profile_rule: P01 emits concrete task-scoped case IDs and runnable adapter bindings. Shared conformance cases are authored/integrated once. A milestone profile runs when its prerequisite artifacts exist; whole-family coverage is required only at declared integration scope. Missing case IDs or skips cannot accept a ready runtime task. N27/N28 contain proposed atomic source/capture cases; P01 freezes executable implementations/adapter selectors. Their IDs alone do not mean tests exist or passed.
